Window.summary: Window control: a top-level container that can be dragged, resized and brought to front on click; its look is drawn by skins. Inherits from Control.

props.resizable: When true the window may be resized by dragging its edge; default true
props.draggable: When true the window may be moved by dragging it; default true
props.bringToFrontOnClick: When true a mouse press brings the window to front; default true
props.noFont: When true no font is used; default true
props.minWidth: Minimum width while resizing, in pixels (50)
props.minHeight: Minimum height while resizing, in pixels (50)

Window:UpdateClientArea.desc: Registers or updates the blur rectangle for the window; the whole implementation is currently commented out and never runs.

Window:New.desc: Creates the instance: with a caption and no explicit noFont a font is allowed, then BringToFront raises the window.

Window:DrawControl.desc: Empty implementation; the window background, title bar and border are drawn by skins.

Window:MouseDown.desc: When bringToFrontOnClick is true it calls BringToFront first, then lets the parent handle the press.

Mouse arguments, forwarded to the parent

Window:TweakDraw.desc: In layout-tweak mode, draws a translucent green overlay and a tiled texture, using the resizable variant for resizable windows.

fileDesc: Window control: a draggable/resizable/click-to-front top-level container whose title bar and border are drawn by skins; TweakDraw is used for layout debugging.
